id: 04_Fire Safety Quiz Fire Alarm Safety Quiz Fire Quiz Fire Safety Interview Question
title: 消防知识竞赛：灭火、报警与喷淋（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/04_Fire Safety Quiz Fire Alarm Safety Quiz Fire Quiz Fire Safety Interview Question.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/04_Fire Safety Quiz Fire Alarm Safety Quiz Fire Quiz Fire Safety Interview Question（国内版）/src.py

points.K2: 灭火器只能喷很短时间
points.K4: 喷头有各自的保护范围
points.K21: 干式系统的两块压力表

shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答台后，台边挂着灭火器，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium with a red fire extinguisher hanging beside it and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 消防知识竞赛开始啦！
overlay: 消防知识竞赛：灭火、报警与喷淋

shots.scene: 两组图标：灭火器、火焰；烟感、喷头
shots.prompt_en: Two groups of icons: a fire extinguisher and a flame on the left, a smoke detector and a sprinkler head on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 前十题讲灭火，后十题讲报警和喷淋。

shots.scene: 阿杰抬头看天花板上的烟感和喷头，一脸茫然
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks up at a smoke detector and a sprinkler head on a laboratory ceiling, puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：天花板上这些圆东西是干啥的？

shots.scene: 老李扛着梯子走来，笑着指向天花板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks in carrying a step ladder and smiles, pointing at the ceiling devices.
shots.narration: 老李说：答完这二十题，你就明白了。

shots.scene: 抢答台上二十张空白题卡分两排
shots.prompt_en: Twenty blank question cards arranged in two rows on a quiz table. No people.
shots.narration: 二十道题，每题先想再看答案。

shots.section_title: 灭火器只能喷很短时间
shots.scene: 灭火器喷出干粉，旁边秒表在转
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher discharging a cloud of powder with a stopwatch ticking beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：一具灭火器能喷多久？
overlay: 灭火器只能喷很短时间

shots.section_title: 灭火器只能喷很短时间
shots.scene: 秒表只转了一小段，灭火器已喷空
shots.prompt_en: The stopwatch shows only a short sweep while the extinguisher is already empty. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答案是三四十秒，只有短短一会儿。

shots.section_title: 灭火器只能喷很短时间
shots.scene: 小研蹲低对准火焰根部，一次扫到位
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student crouches low and aims an extinguisher at the base of a small tray fire in a training area.
shots.narration: 所以要对准火根，别浪费在火苗上。

shots.section_title: 灭火器只能喷很短时间
shots.scene: 王老师指着铭牌，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at the blank label on an extinguisher with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 不同型号时间不同，看铭牌和培训。

shots.scene: 人和火之间一条虚线，脚印停在线外
shots.prompt_en: A dashed line between a person icon and a flame, with footprints stopping outside the line. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：灭火时离火多远？

shots.scene: 太近被热浪烤到的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person too close to a flame with heat waves, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 太近会被烤伤，太远又喷不到。

shots.scene: 小研站在合适距离、站在上风处
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a safe distance upwind of a training fire, aiming the extinguisher.
shots.narration: 保持安全距离，站在上风方向。

shots.section_title: 喷头有各自的保护范围
shots.scene: 天花板上一排喷头，每个下面一个圆形水雾区
shots.prompt_en: A row of sprinkler heads on a ceiling, each with a circular spray zone below it. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：一个喷头能管多大范围？
overlay: 喷头有各自的保护范围

shots.section_title: 喷头有各自的保护范围
shots.scene: 水雾圆圈相互衔接，覆盖整个房间
shots.prompt_en: The circular spray zones overlap to cover the whole room floor. No people.
shots.narration: 每个喷头只管一小片，排在一起才盖满。

shots.section_title: 喷头有各自的保护范围
shots.scene: 空白设计图纸和圆规
shots.prompt_en: A blank design drawing with a compass and ruler. No people.
shots.narration: 间距按设计规范布置，不能随便改。

shots.scene: 烟雾中一个人被困在火边，其他人在安全处
shots.prompt_en: In a smoky room, one person is trapped near flames while others stand safely by the door.
shots.narration: 第四题：着火了，先救谁？

shots.scene: 被困者头顶闪烁红色感叹号
shots.prompt_en: A flashing red exclamation icon above the trapped person.
shots.narration: 先救处在直接危险中的人。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员带着人往外撤，自己没冲进火里
shots.prompt_en: The security officer guides people out of the smoky corridor without running into the flames himself.
shots.narration: 救人也要先保护好自己。

shots.scene: 小研灭火时，背后是绿色安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses an extinguisher on a small fire with a green emergency exit sign directly behind her.
shots.narration: 第五题：灭火时该朝哪儿站？

shots.scene: 面朝出口、背对火的图标打叉；背对出口面向火的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a person with the exit in front and fire behind, crossed out; a person facing the fire with the exit behind, checked. No people.
shots.narration: 背对出口、面向火，退路就在身后。

shots.scene: 火势变大，小研转身从身后出口撤出
shots.prompt_en: The fire grows larger; the female graduate student turns and leaves through the exit behind her.
shots.narration: 火控制不住，转身就能撤。

shots.scene: 四个手势图标：拔销、对准、压把、扫射
shots.prompt_en: Four step icons in a row: pulling a pin, aiming a nozzle, squeezing a handle and sweeping side to side. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：灭火器怎么操作？

shots.scene: 小研依次做四步动作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls the pin, aims at the base of a training fire, squeezes the handle and sweeps.
shots.narration: 拔掉保险销，对准火根，压下把手，左右扫。

shots.scene: 另一组图标：救人、报警、控制、撤离
shots.prompt_en: Another row of icons: rescuing a person, an alarm bell, a closed door and an exit arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 另一套口诀，讲的是整个火灾应对程序。

shots.scene: 木块、纸张、塑料盒图标，配火焰
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wooden block, a stack of paper and a plastic box beside a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：木材、纸张、塑料是哪类火？

shots.scene: 三个图标归入一个A类框
shots.prompt_en: The three icons slide into one box marked with a solid block icon. No people.
shots.narration: A类，固体物质火灾。

shots.scene: 实验室纸箱、擦拭纸堆在角落，被小研清走
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student clears away a pile of cardboard boxes and used wipes from a laboratory corner.
shots.narration: 实验室的纸箱和废纸，别堆在角落。

shots.scene: 医院走廊，几张病床和轮椅
shots.prompt_en: A hospital corridor with beds and wheelchairs during an evacuation drill.
shots.narration: 第八题：医院着火，先疏散哪些病人？

shots.scene: 能走的人沿箭头先撤，护工集中照顾轮椅和病床
shots.prompt_en: Walking patients exit along arrows first, while staff focus on wheelchairs and beds.
shots.narration: 先撤能行走的，再集中力量转移行动不便的。

shots.scene: 实验室里小研陪同腿受伤的阿杰撤离
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory, the female graduate student helps the young male student with an injured leg toward the exit.
shots.narration: 实验室里，行动不便的同学安排专人协助。

shots.scene: 三个图标：水滴、移走的木块、盖子
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a water drop, a wooden block being moved away and a lid covering a pan. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：灭火有哪些方法？

shots.scene: 水滴图标亮起，温度计下降
shots.prompt_en: The water drop icon glows and a thermometer drops. No people.
shots.narration: 冷却：把温度降下来。

shots.scene: 可燃物被移开，火焰变小
shots.prompt_en: Fuel is moved away and the flame shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离：把可燃物拿开。

shots.scene: 灭火毯盖住小火
shots.prompt_en: A fire blanket smothers a small fire on a lab bench. No people.
shots.narration: 窒息：隔绝空气。三种都对。

shots.scene: 红色三角形，三边是火焰、木块、空气图标
shots.prompt_en: A red triangle with a flame, a block of wood and an air swirl on its sides. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：火三角是哪三样？

shots.scene: 三角形拆掉一边，火熄灭
shots.prompt_en: One side of the triangle is removed and the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 热、氧气、可燃物，少一样就不着。

shots.scene: 小研发现冒烟，立刻按下墙上的手动报警按钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sees smoke and immediately presses a manual fire alarm call point on the wall.
shots.narration: 发现火情，第一件事是报警。

shots.scene: 阿杰打电话，手机屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes an urgent phone call in the corridor.
shots.narration: 拨打119，同时打校内报警电话。

shots.scene: 小研向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reports the fire to the older man by phone.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人和学院。

shots.scene: 墙上的红色手动报警按钮和警铃
shots.prompt_en: A red manual call point and an alarm bell on a corridor wall. No people.
shots.narration: 报警第一题：最基本的报警系统靠什么启动？

shots.scene: 一只手按下按钮，警铃响
shots.prompt_en: A hand presses the call point and the bell rings with sound waves. No people.
shots.narration: 靠人手动启动，最基本的一种。

shots.scene: 按钮前堆着纸箱的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boxes blocking a manual call point, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 报警按钮前别堆东西。

shots.scene: 探测器连线到控制室，线缆、光纤、无线信号图标
shots.prompt_en: A detector connected to a control room by a cable, a fiber line and wireless signal waves. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：自动报警怎样传出信号？

shots.scene: 控制室里保卫处值班员看着空白屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The security officer watches a blank fire alarm control panel in a monitoring room.
shots.narration: 经专线、电话线、光缆或无线，传到值班室。

shots.scene: 三个探测器图标：温度计、上升箭头温度计、烟雾
shots.prompt_en: Three detector icons: a thermometer, a thermometer with a rising arrow and a smoke cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：自动报警靠什么触发？

shots.scene: 三个图标依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three icons light up one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 温度到了、升温太快、烟雾来了，都会报警。

shots.scene: 两个感烟探测器剖面图标：一个有小放射源符号，一个有光束
shots.prompt_en: Two smoke detector cross-section icons: one with a small ion chamber symbol, one with a light beam and sensor. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：感烟探测器分哪两大类？

shots.scene: 两个图标都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Both icons get green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 离子型和光电型。

shots.scene: 一团浓白烟慢慢冒出，没有明火；光电探测器亮起
shots.prompt_en: Thick white smoke slowly rises from a smoldering pile without flames; the light beam detector icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：光电型对哪种火更灵敏？

shots.scene: 光束被烟粒散射的示意
shots.prompt_en: A light beam being scattered by smoke particles inside a detector chamber. No people.
shots.narration: 对冒浓烟、没明火的阴燃火更灵敏。

shots.scene: 明火窜起，烟少；离子探测器亮起
shots.prompt_en: A fast flaming fire with little visible smoke; the ion chamber detector icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：离子型对哪种火反应快？

shots.scene: 两种探测器图标并排，各配一种火
shots.prompt_en: The two detector icons side by side, each paired with its fire type icon. No people.
shots.narration: 对燃烧迅速的明火反应更快。

shots.scene: 喷头喷水浇在火上，楼上的人安全
shots.prompt_en: A sprinkler sprays water directly onto a fire while people on the upper floor of a building cross-section stay safe.
shots.narration: 第七题：自动喷水对人有什么用？

shots.scene: 三个图标：上层的人、水浇火、烟雾变少
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: people on an upper floor, water on a flame and a shrinking smoke cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 楼上人员更易逃生，水直接浇火，烟气减少。

shots.scene: 三个图标一起打勾
shots.prompt_en: All three icons receive green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 三条都对。

shots.scene: 建筑外墙上的消防接口，消防车停在旁边
shots.prompt_en: A fire department inlet connection on the outside wall of a building with a fire truck parked beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：消防车往哪里给楼里供水？

shots.scene: 消防水带接到接口，水流进楼内管网
shots.prompt_en: A fire hose connected to the inlet, with water arrows flowing into the building's pipe network. No people.
shots.narration: 通过外墙上的水泵接合器，往楼里加压。

shots.scene: 接合器前停自行车的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bicycles parked in front of the inlet connection, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 接合器前不能停车堆物。

shots.scene: 管道里水流动，报警铃响
shots.prompt_en: Water flowing through a sprinkler pipe triggers a ringing alarm bell. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：水流报警是干什么的？

shots.scene: 喷头动作和管道漏水两个图标都连到警铃
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, an activated sprinkler head and a leaking pipe, both connected to the alarm bell. No people.
shots.narration: 喷淋管里有水流动，就会报警。

shots.scene: 室外墙上的水力警铃
shots.prompt_en: A water motor alarm gong mounted on an outside wall. No people.
shots.narration: 原题说的是装在室外、靠近接口的警铃。

shots.section_title: 干式系统的两块压力表
shots.scene: 干式阀门剖面：上面充气，下面有水，两块压力表
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of a dry pipe valve: air above the clapper, water below, with two pressure gauges. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：干式系统两块表，谁的读数高？
overlay: 干式系统的两块压力表

shots.section_title: 干式系统的两块压力表
shots.scene: 上面的气压表指针低，下面的水压表指针高
shots.prompt_en: The upper air gauge needle reads low while the lower water gauge needle reads high. No people.
shots.narration: 上方气压明显低于下方水压。

shots.section_title: 干式系统的两块压力表
shots.scene: 寒冷的仓库，管道里只有空气
shots.prompt_en: A cold unheated storage building with sprinkler pipes filled with air. No people.
shots.narration: 干式系统用在会结冰的地方。

shots.scene: 实验室里气瓶接口冒火，小研去关总阀
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory, a small flame appears at a gas line joint; the female graduate student reaches to close the main cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 气体着火，先关阀断气。

shots.scene: 活泼金属着火，水桶图标打叉，干沙图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a burning reactive metal: a water bucket crossed out and a bucket of dry sand checked. No people.
shots.narration: 活泼金属着火，不能用水。

shots.scene: 仪器冒烟，先拉电闸
shots.prompt_en: An instrument smoking on a bench; a hand switches off the power at the wall breaker.
shots.narration: 电器着火，先断电再灭火。

shots.scene: 通风柜内小火，拉下柜门
shots.prompt_en: A small fire inside a fume hood; the female graduate student lowers the sash.
shots.narration: 通风柜里着火，先拉下柜门。

shots.scene: 喷头上挂着衣物的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of clothes hung on a sprinkler head, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 喷头上不挂东西，下方不堆高物。

shots.scene: 烟感被塑料袋套住的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a smoke detector covered with a plastic bag, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能遮挡烟感，不能擅自停用。

shots.scene: 老李登记后临时处理，王老师在旁签字
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer reviews a request form with the safety administrator before any temporary work near a detector.
shots.narration: 会产烟的操作，先报备再处理。

shots.scene: 专用柜里存放遇水危险物品，柜门有警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A dedicated storage cabinet with a dangerous-when-wet warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 遇水危险的物品，要放专门柜子。

shots.scene: 喷头图标与遇水危险标志之间画问号
shots.prompt_en: A sprinkler head icon and a dangerous-when-wet sign with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 存放场所的消防设施，要事先评估。

shots.scene: 楼道里学生低姿沿墙走，电梯图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Students move along a smoky corridor in a low crouch beside the wall; an elevator icon is crossed out.
shots.narration: 撤离走楼梯，烟大就低姿前进。

shots.scene: 最后离开的人随手关门
shots.prompt_en: The last person out of the laboratory closes the door behind them.
shots.narration: 离开时随手关门，挡住烟火。

shots.scene: 集合点清点人数
shots.prompt_en: At the outdoor assembly point, the safety administrator counts students with a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 到集合点报到，不返回取东西。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白法规书旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside thick blank law books with a fire extinguisher icon.
shots.narration: 消防法规定：发现火灾要立即报警。

shots.scene: 空白标准书一摞，配烟感和喷头图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of blank standard books with smoke detector and sprinkler icons. No people.
shots.narration: 报警、喷淋、灭火器，都有国家标准。

shots.scene: 王老师合上书，提示图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator closes a blank book with a reminder icon.
shots.narration: 具体要求，以现行文本和本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a whiteboard with fire safety icons.
shots.narration: 竞赛结束，回顾一下。

shots.scene: 图标：电话、四步手势、背对出口
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a telephone, four extinguisher step icons and a person with an exit behind. No people.
shots.narration: 先报警，会四步，背对出口灭火。

shots.scene: 图标：烟感、喷头、警铃
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a smoke detector, a sprinkler head and an alarm bell. No people.
shots.narration: 烟感喷头不遮挡，报警按钮不堵塞。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着天花板，竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at the ceiling smoke detector and gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：这下我知道它们是干啥的了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the fire extinguisher on the wall.
shots.narration: 防火常记心，下次见！
